messages:
Noah: Quick sync for benchmark narrative — pushed a stripped-down storyboard to the drive: https://rwd.internal/bench-playbook. Goal: 600-800 word blog + 20-min webinar. Main ask: which single stat should headline the marketing slide? :thinking:
Priya: Recommend a money-focused headline for marketing folks. Something like 'Reduce token spend by X% for typical chat workloads'. Need X to be defensible across our sample set. 
Zoe: From the sweep I ran: median cost reduction 42% for chat-small when using batching+cache; ranges 25-60 depending on sequence length. I'd avoid a single absolute % without an explicit sample caveat. 
Connor: For technical buyers we should pair that stat with p95 improvement. In my runs the p95 latency drops by ~2.7x with prefix caching. Headline could be two-part: money + reliability (short hyphenated phrase). 
Sam: CTA question: do we want the blog CTA = "Try the tuned config" (self-serve) or "Schedule capacity review" (sales)? Marketing needs routing rules so we can wire the form. My vote: self-serve CTA on blog, webinar CTA = schedule (capture org size). 
Noah: Good split. Marketing headline draft: 'Lower inference cost up to 60% — keep application latency predictable with caching.' We can tighten wording. 
Priya: I'll run a short A/B on two headlines: money-first vs hybrid (money + latency). Also add a small inset clarifying assumptions (model family, avg seq len, cache warm state). 
Zoe: Data snippet for appendix (CSV-like):
```
workload,config,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd
chat-short,baseline,40,210,0.11
chat-short,batch32,36,180,0.08
chat-short,batch32+cache,33,75,0.055
chat-long,baseline,130,740,0.42
chat-long,batch16,115,600,0.31
chat-long,batch16+cache,95,200,0.19
```
Connor: Design ask: lead visual should be one concise stat card + small two-panel chart: left = cost delta bars, right = p95 change (log y). I'll mock the layout. Use green for cost improvement and blue for latency improvement. 
Sam: Routing fields for webinar sign-up (draft): org name, org size, infra contact, primary use-case (chat/embeddings/rerank), desired deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), urgency. Map org size >250 and "private" to sales higher touch. 
eng-bench-bot: sweep 2026-47 finished. Artifacts: s3://bench/2026/sw-47/{full.csv,plots.zip}. Summary: chat-small median cost delta = 42%, p95 latency median improvement 2.7x with cache. 
Noah: Nice. Small marketing copy idea: short lead + one-sentence explainer under the stat referencing "config-level caching and batching". 
Priya: Also propose an explainer GIF for twitter/LinkedIn showing before/after cost bars. Keeps engagement. :rocket: 
Zoe: One more data recommendation: include a tiny methodology note showing how we compute cost per 1k tokens in the SDK. Example: 
```
resp = client.generate(model='open-rwd-1', prompt=prompt)
print(resp.metrics.tokens_total, resp.metrics.cost_usd)
```
Noah: Action items: Zoe finalize CSVs + methodology (due Wed EOD), Connor provide two visual mockups (marketing + appendix) by Thu, Priya run headline A/B and give top pick by Fri, Sam wire routing form to HubSpot and provide mapping by Fri, Noah will draft blog intro and compose webinar outline. 
Sam: I'll also add a hidden utm param 'source=bench-playbook' for tracking. 
Connor: Tagging design channel for brand check: <#design> :eyes: 
Noah: Great — if no objections I'll lock the headline variants tomorrow morning and share for final review. Thanks! :thumbsup:
